structured_output.what_is_happening: EKnSU…zDx ("DESKS") is one of 10+ tokens with the same DESKS/desks.fun name, all launched within about an hour. They all follow the same path: a Meteora DBC launch, an immediate migration to a Meteora pool, then a PumpSwap pool. Each has run up several hundred percent on about $0.2M–$1.8M of hourly volume. They borrow the name of desks.fun, an early-access site for launching AI trading agents on Hyperliquid (X handle @desksdotfun). The site says tokens are "optional" and it does not publish a contract address. This token was at about $208k mcap and +45% over 5 minutes at the latest check. Its Meteora pool has been drained to $4.71. About half of the copies in the packet already show $0 liquidity, and one competitor (FTJm…) dropped 50% in 5 minutes.

narrative.description: Borrows the name of desks.fun, an early-stage product for launching AI trading agents on Hyperliquid. I found no news, launch announcement, or organic discussion anywhere.
narrative.why_spreading: The money looks driven by the launch factory, not by a story. Many identical copies were created back to back, and each shows about 2,000 unique buyers but fewer than 100 unique sellers in its first hour, which fits volume bots or airdrop-style wallet farming. I found no organic posts.

token_connection.why_this_token: GMGN links this token to the desks.fun website, and it was launched through the Meteora virtual curve. The site says tokens are optional and names no contract address. I could not open the X account (HTTP 402), so I cannot confirm any token is official.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name tokens. 4QXA… is bigger ($318k mcap, $54k liquidity). FTJm… has more volume ($1.78M in 1h) but fell 50% in 5 minutes. Several copies (U7VQ, 8vh2, AB8h, 2CNE, 9271, 2TKp) have $0 or near-$0 liquidity, meaning they are already rugged or dead.

authenticity.evidence: Serial copies with the same name and the same launch path: Meteora DBC, then Meteora, then PumpSwap. GMGN shows the image duplicated 6 times. In the first hour there were 2,098 unique buyers but only 95 unique sellers. In the last 30 minutes there were only 74 buyers, so most of the 'buyers' arrived early in bulk. GMGN flags 25 bundler wallets and RugCheck detects a 52-wallet insider trade network. The creator has launched 10 tokens and has already closed out of this one. There is no DexScreener profile and no socials.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts, so I cannot rule out a real desks.fun launch that the team itself endorses.

structural_risks: RugCheck: a large share of LP is unlocked ('Large Amount of LP Unlocked', danger level) and there are few LP providers. The PumpSwap LP is 0% locked in one of the top markets.
One unlabelled wallet holds 80.05% of supply according to RugCheck, and GeckoTerminal puts the top 10 at 95%. GMGN shows only 7% for its top 10, so the data sources conflict.
The Meteora pool is already drained to $4.71.
Copycat tokens split demand, and many copies have already had liquidity pulled.

structured_output.counterargument: The whole DESKS cluster is getting real speculative flow, over $1M per hour per token. One copy (4QXA) is already at $318k, so a move from about $200k to over $400k is not far-fetched. If desks.fun or a KOL names this contract address, it could double fast. The latest 5-minute candle is +45%, with buyers and sellers roughly even at 53 vs 47. GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0, which conflicts with RugCheck's LP-unlocked warning.
unknowns: Whether @desksdotfun has endorsed any contract address
Who the 80.05% holder FhVo… is (a pool/vault or a single wallet)
Whether the PumpSwap LP can be pulled (RugCheck says unlocked, GMGN says burned)

source_coverage.notes: desks.fun fetched: an AI agent launchpad, no contract address listed. x.com returned 402. Searches for the contract address and $DESKS turned up only unrelated DESK/OTC Desks projects. Checked DexScreener pairs for this token and three competitors.

structured_output.thesis: A copy from a serial same-name launch factory, borrowing the name of an unlaunched AI-agent product. Signs of wash or bot volume, insider bundles, a creator who has already exited, a drained side pool, and sibling copies already rugged. The chance of doubling from about $200k before a -50% move or a rug is low.
